title: Bee Removal in Kingsbridge, Bronx
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Kingsbridge, Bronx. Licensed technicians. Nest treatment, removal, and sealing. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Active wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in your Kingsbridge home or business? The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging-insect removal throughout this historic Bronx neighborhood. Our licensed technicians locate nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, and chimneys — then treat, remove, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization. We also treat carpenter bee galleries and ground-nesting bee colonies.
whyUs: With over a decade serving Kingsbridge's diverse mix of pre-war apartments, row houses, and local businesses, we understand the unique pest challenges of this Northwest Bronx community. Our bee removal experts respond quickly, work efficiently, and guarantee complete hive extraction at competitive rates from $350 to $550.
localContext: From the bustling Kingsbridge Road shopping corridor to the residential streets near Van Cortlandt Park, wasp and hornet colonies often establish paper nests in building overhangs, chimneys, and wall cavities common in Kingsbridge's early 20th-century architecture. The neighborhood's tree-lined blocks and proximity to green spaces make it particularly attractive to yellow jackets and ground-nesting bees during spring and summer months.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Kingsbridge property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Kingsbridge. Our team typically arrives within 2–4 hours for emergency situations and can complete most residential nest treatments in a single visit, depending on nest location and access.

faqs.question: What's included in the bee removal price?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Kingsbridge?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Are wasps and hornets common in Kingsbridge apartment buildings?
faqs.answer: Yes, Kingsbridge's many pre-war apartment buildings with brick facades, old ventilation systems, and roof access provide ideal nesting spots for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets. We frequently service buildings along Kingsbridge Avenue, Sedgwick Avenue, and the surrounding residential blocks, particularly during spring and summer nesting season from April through June.
